items.title: Trace security threats in multi-agent pipelines with Amazon OpenSearch Service
items.summary: Learn how to trace two invisible threats in a multi-agent AI pipeline, prompt injection propagation and cross-tenant data exfiltration, using Amazon OpenSearch Service and Amazon Bedrock. Instrument every agent hop with embeddings, provenance, and PII detection, reconstruct the attack path, and add guardrails that stop these attacks before they reach production.
items.creator: Jon Handler
